A quieter way to experience music.

Spartial is a free, open-source music app for Android, built around simplicity, discovery and listening together.

DownloadFeatures
  • Free and open source
  • Android 8.0 and newer
  • Guest mode, no account needed
Join the Telegram channel for release dates, updates and beta builds

Discover your rhythm

A closer look at Spartial: sign in or stay a guest, find new music, and listen together in sessions.

Everything in one calm place

Your music, discovery, music videos and your friends, together in one refined interface.

Personalized onboarding

  • Sign in with Google, or continue as a guest without creating an account.
  • Choose your own avatar.
  • A listener identity that is yours, from the first launch.

Home

  • Featured music and recommendations.
  • New songs you may like.
  • Trending community playlists and curated collections.
  • Quick access to different music categories.

Spartial Reel

  • Explore music videos through a Reel-style interface.
  • Like, save and share music content.
  • Add what you find to your playlists.
  • Discover new music through video.

Discovery and search

  • Search across your active music sources.
  • Find songs, artists and albums.
  • Browse by genre and explore popular categories.
  • Filter results and browse new music.

Your library

  • Your personal music library.
  • Create and manage playlists.
  • Liked songs and recently added music.
  • Organized collections.

Now Playing

  • A full-screen player built around the artwork.
  • Playback controls, queue and upcoming tracks.
  • Shuffle and repeat controls.
  • Integrated casting controls.

Sessions: listen together

  • Create a listening session.
  • Join with a room code.
  • Personalized listener avatars and member information.
  • Synchronized playback controls for the room.

Design and experience

  • A minimal, dark interface.
  • Careful typography and rounded, refined components.
  • Consistent navigation throughout.
  • Immersive album artwork.

Changelog

What changed in each release. The full notes live on GitHub.

Spartial v1.0.0: Initial Release

Latest

A quieter way to experience music.

Introducing Spartial, a thoughtfully crafted music experience for Android, built around simplicity, discovery and listening together. It brings your music and listening experience together in one place, combining a refined interface with music discovery, video content, personalized libraries and social listening features. This is just the beginning.

Personalized onboarding

  • Sign in with Google.
  • Continue as a guest without creating an account.
  • Choose your own avatar.
  • Personalized listener identity.
  • Simple and welcoming onboarding experience.

Home

  • Personalized home screen.
  • Featured music and recommendations.
  • New songs you may like.
  • Trending community playlists.
  • Curated music collections.
  • Quick access to different music categories.

Spartial Reel

  • Dedicated music video discovery experience.
  • Explore music videos through a Reel-style interface.
  • Like, save and share music content.
  • Add content to your playlists.
  • Discover new music through video.

Music discovery and search

  • Search across active music sources.
  • Discover songs, artists and albums.
  • Browse music by genre.
  • Explore popular music categories.
  • Dedicated search results and filtering.
  • Browse new music and recommendations.

Your library

  • Personal music library.
  • Create and manage playlists.
  • Access liked songs.
  • Recently added music.
  • Organized music collections.

Now Playing

  • Dedicated full-screen Now Playing interface.
  • Album artwork-focused presentation.
  • Playback controls.
  • Play queue and upcoming tracks.
  • Shuffle and repeat controls.
  • Quick access to additional playback options.
  • Integrated casting controls.

Sessions: listen together

  • Create listening sessions.
  • Join sessions using a room code.
  • Personalized listener avatars.
  • Shared listening experience.
  • Session member information.
  • Synchronized playback controls for the listening room.

Design and experience

  • Minimal, dark-themed interface.
  • Carefully designed typography and layouts.
  • Rounded components and refined visual details.
  • Consistent navigation throughout the application.
  • Immersive album artwork presentation.
  • A design philosophy focused on simplicity and usability.
Our philosophy

Spartial is built around a simple idea: music deserves a beautiful listening experience. We believe a music player should feel thoughtful, intuitive and enjoyable without unnecessary complexity. No unnecessary clutter. No overwhelming customization. Just music and a carefully crafted experience.

Credits

Conceptualized and planned by M4TRX. Designed and developed by Chikku.

What's next

This is the first chapter of Spartial. More refinements, improvements and features are planned as the project evolves. Thank you for being part of the beginning. Welcome to Spartial.
